Fixed. The bug was in `_cstack` in `astropy/modeling/separable.py`: when the right operand of a `&` operation was already a coord matrix (i.e., a nested compound model), the code filled its output block with all-1s (`= 1`) instead of copying the child's separability matrix (`= right`), making nested models' inputs/outputs appear mutually dependent.

**Verification:**
- `separability_matrix(m.Pix2Sky_TAN() & cm)` now returns the correct matrix matching the flat equivalent (diagonal for the linear models, coupled only within Pix2Sky_TAN).
- All 11 tests in `test_separable.py` pass; full modeling suite shows the same pre-existing failure count as without the fix (no regressions); module doctests pass.
